Title: Gauge-parameter cancellation and finite form factors in one-loop quark scattering in the refined Gribov-Zwanziger framework
SourceKind: Author-supplied exact electronic table accompanying the referenced PDFs
Scope: Two dynamical flavors, distinct massless external quarks, alpha=0, M->0+, one-loop finite correction excluding the Born term
BranchPrescription: rMinus/rPlus use the square root continued from the declared Euclidean domain; denominators carry +i0; logarithms and finite functions remain on the same sheet. Crossing a Landau singularity requires a separate boundary analysis.
Domain: Nonzero nondegenerate internal squared masses; positive real parts in the Euclidean endpoint domain; nonexceptional s,t,u with u=-s-t; positive MSbar scale squared. Full live-task conditions must be retained from the linked evidence.
Normalization: Prefactors already include the common loop normalization; do not multiply by another 1/(16 Pi^2). All integral mass arguments are squared masses.
Indexing: Function index j refers to Functions[[j+1]]; j=0 is the rational remainder.
ColorConvention: ColorID 1 is delta31 delta42; ColorID 2 is T^a31 T^a42, the singlet/octet basis.
